summary: C0-16ND3 digital input module arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: C0-16ND3 is the drawing identifier for digital input module in AutomationDirect's CLICK PLCs collection. A digital input module reports discrete conditions such as a switch being open or closed. The selected wiring and electrical data establish how each input is supplied and referenced.

For example, in a pump panel collecting status from level and position switches, use the C0-16ND3 reference to coordinate field-input terminals, identification labels and module replacement. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as PLC Families/CLICK/C0-16ND3.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
